title: 引用块预览应显示链接文本而不是 Markdown 源码

targets.guidance: the conversation titled "黄悦龙Aaron, 黄悦龙-AgentEval, aaron+test2" (titles may be cut short with …)

prepareCheck.expect: 会话里出现引用了该链接消息的引用块

checks.expect: 引用块预览不出现 Markdown 链接语法 [..](..)（链接只显示一次）

preconditions.text: 一条含 Markdown 链接语法的消息被引用回复

trigger.text: When a message whose content contains a Markdown link is quoted in a reply, the quote block preview on iOS renders the raw Markdown source instead of a parsed link. The link is shown as '[https://github.com/TensorOpera-Inc/chat-web/pull/654](https://github.com/TensorOpera-Inc/chat-web/pull/654)', so

params.conversation: 黄悦龙Aaron, 黄悦龙-AgentEval, aaron+test2

observable.text: The quote block preview shows the quoted message as plain display text: the link appears only once (either the URL or its label, optionally as a link), with no Markdown syntax such as '[', '](' or ')'. The preview should match how the original message bubble renders the link.
observable.phenomenon: The quote block preview prints the Markdown link source verbatim: '[https://github.com/TensorOpera-Inc/chat-web/pull/654](https://github.com/TensorOpera-Inc/chat-web/pull/654) 测...'. The URL is displayed twice (once as the label in brackets, once as the target in parentheses), taking two lines of the preview and truncating the actual quoted text.

substitution.reason: ios 端当前无可用执行端（设备池只有 Android 真机，Web 用 Playwright）。替代为 android-app（同为原生移动端交互：长按/键盘/触控）或 mobile-web（同一 Web 代码的手机视口 + 触屏）；结论不能直接代表 ios 端。
